notes: Ports wps_psbegin macro to Jenner. The original wraps a DATA _NULL_ + FILE + CARDS4-driven PUT _INFILE_ pattern; here we keep the macro signature and the FILENAME/FILE/PUT mechanics but inline the script lines as literal PUT statements, then read the generated file back to verify. The macro keeps its host name (wps_psbegin_jenner) so it composes with adapted versions of the companion macros.
